mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.4%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 0.4% condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in low-rate environments are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals tight labor market conditions that support wage growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 0.4%) and inflation is high (CPIAUCSL > 240), the market perceives stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between the joint signal (FEDFUNDS < 0.4% and CPIAUCSL > 240) and negative 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high housing starts (HOUST > 1200) indicate overextension of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production level (INDPRO > 100) indicates strong economic output supporting corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return correlation with INDPRO > 100 is negative (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1200 (HOUST > 1200), it reflects robust consumer demand for housing, boosting economic growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in employment (PAYEMS > 144000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 450000) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (PAYEMS > 144000 and RSAFS > 450000) does not produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), higher interest rates reduce equity attractiveness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.
